evidence.reason: The triage judge gate checks `runner_disabled()` and the GLM blackout, but never checks `dispatch_paused(config)`. `drain()` checks the pause only at the start of the pass, so a pause that appears during the pass, or a standalone `--triage-dry-run` path whose `phase` invokes the judge, can still reach `dispatch(...)` at line 785 and make a provider call. This is an ordinary implementation defect in the intended rate-limit behavior, not a new requirement; the smallest fix is to add a `dispatch_paused` guard next to the blackout guard and return a deferred result.
